checks.method: Read F17 arXiv lines 982–1013 and 1184–1188, then A1K lines 164–175, against the manuscript's source discussion.
checks.observation: Section 6.3 describes the 28-row enumeration with dynamic introduction of fresh points. Section 8 states a narrower Lean scope and separately checked exhaustive computations. A1K explicitly attributes the 85-point support argument to equation 6.13 and identifies its own contribution as checked transport. These passages support the manuscript's relative contribution and its caution that smaller static representation counts need not yield measured acceleration of canonical enumeration. I did not replay that enumeration or assess literature-wide priority.

content.summary: The source comparison supports the report's separation of the external enumeration from its own formal reduction. Both frozen hashes and the inspected F17 digest match. The citation does not justify importing an external exclusion into the local protected proof, and the manuscript correctly refrains from doing so.
